title: Home
excerpt: Medivora is a field guide to AI automation in pharma — covering workflow automation, agentic AI, and how they fit together across the value chain.

title: Foundations
excerpt: Workflow automation follows defined rules. Agentic automation reasons through ambiguity. One follows the rules — the other writes its own.

title: The Deterministic Pipeline
excerpt: Workflow automation moves structured work between systems along a predefined path. Rule-based, auditable, brittle at the edges.

title: The Reasoning Operator
excerpt: Agentic automation uses LLMs to reason through ambiguous inputs, call tools, and orchestrate multi-step work with minimal supervision.

title: Which Automation? Decision Tool
excerpt: Answer 3 questions to find out whether your use case calls for Workflow automation, Agentic automation, or both.

title: Value Chain
excerpt: Seven stages of the pharma value chain — from drug discovery to pharmacy operations — mapped to automation opportunities.

title: Drug Discovery & R&D
excerpt: AI agents accelerate hypothesis generation, literature review, and target identification. Agentic automation dominates early discovery.

title: Clinical Trials & Development
excerpt: Workflow automation handles protocol submissions and site monitoring data. Agents assist with patient matching and safety signal detection.

title: Regulatory Affairs & Submissions
excerpt: Deterministic pipelines assemble submission dossiers. Agentic tools draft responses to agency queries and monitor label changes.

title: Pharmacovigilance & Drug Safety
excerpt: Agents triage safety signals from adverse event reports, social media, and literature. Workflow automation routes cases through MedDRA coding.

title: Manufacturing & Quality (GxP)
excerpt: GxP-compliant workflow automation handles batch records, CAPA, and deviation management. Agentic AI assists with root-cause analysis.

title: Supply Chain & Distribution
excerpt: Workflow automation manages purchase orders and inventory. Agentic AI forecasts demand and flags supply disruptions across multiple suppliers.

title: Pharmacy Operations
excerpt: Agentic systems assist pharmacists with clinical decision support, drug interaction checking, and medication therapy management.

title: Case Studies
excerpt: Real-world automation stories from drug discovery to the pharmacy counter — what worked, what failed, and why.

title: Responsible Adoption
excerpt: The human stays central. Guardrails, validation, bias awareness, and the limits of automation in regulated healthcare.

title: Road Ahead
excerpt: The predictive pipeline, AI-native discovery, self-driving supply chains. Where pharma automation is heading by 2030.

title: Glossary
excerpt: Plain-English definitions for 50+ automation and AI terms used in pharma — from Agent to Zero-shot prompting.

title: About
excerpt: Medivora is an independent field guide for pharma and biotech teams navigating AI automation — not a vendor, not a consultancy.

title: Contact
excerpt: Suggest a case study, flag an error, or just say hello. Medivora welcomes corrections and contributions from industry practitioners.
